title: AcknowledgementReceivedPayload
description: Payload of the AcknowledgementReceived event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Payload (catalogue text): adapter, AP notification ID, docUuid, version, acknowledgementId, outcome (ACCEPTED or REJECTED; absent reads as ACCEPTED), reasons (code and message, present on a rejection). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

adapter.description: The Access Point adapter that received the acknowledgement.

apNotificationId.description: The Access Point's own notification identifier.

outcome.description: An absent value reads as ACCEPTED, so every earlier event stays valid. For REJECTED the acknowledgementId is the apNotificationId of the rejection notification (ruling INV-Q-9772 A).

reasons.description: The reasons of a rejection, present when outcome is REJECTED.
